metadata.description: A growing collection of custom Claude Code skills.

plugins.name: explain-code
plugins.description: Explains code block by block, with snippets, line links, domain-aware terms, and callouts for complex logic.

plugins.name: dirmap
plugins.description: Gives every folder a short DIRMAP.md so AI coding agents find code by following maps instead of searching, and keeps the maps current with one command. No hooks and no git: works in any agent that reads AGENTS.md.
